svg.title: rondOfeed wiring
svg.text: Schematic only: pins are grouped for clarity and are not in their physical order. Check the labels on your boards.
• Mains wiring only by someone qualified. Cover the mains terminals. Keep 230 V and low voltage apart.
• Never connect or disconnect the motor while powered. Find the coil pairs with a multimeter.
• R3 pulls GP6 up to 3V3, the phototransistor pulls it low while it sees the IR LED. R2 sets the LED current to about 20 mA.
• D1 keeps the 5 V supply from feeding back when USB is plugged in. Connect OUT− and IN− if the converter does not.
• Set the motor current on the breakout potentiometer before longer tests. Motor stays off while EN is high.
• Proposal, not yet built or tested.
